QuestionStmt.S: Only 4% of the total current in the circuit passes through a galvanometer. If the resistance of the galvanometer is G, then the shunt resistance connected to the galvanometer is

Solution.S:
Let total current be $I$. Current through galvanometer $I_G = 4\%$ of $I = \frac{I}{25}$.

Current through shunt $I_S = I - I_G = I - \frac{I}{25} = \frac{24I}{25}$.

Since galvanometer and shunt are in parallel, $I_G G = I_S S$.

$$\frac{I}{25} G = \frac{24I}{25} S \Rightarrow G = 24S \Rightarrow S = \frac{G}{24}$$

Thus the correct option is B: $\frac{G}{24}$.
